q: Compare last week's performance against this week and identify the likely causes.

checks.what: tool: compares against last week or same weekdays last week

answer:
Short answer — For Tilting Heads: this week so far (Mon–Wed) performance dropped sharply: net sales fell to ₹135,833 from ₹645,611 last week, orders fell to 72 from 339, and ad spend fell to ₹90,799 from ₹430,736; net profit moved from a loss of ₹65,119 last week to a small profit of ₹2,139 this week. (Measured)

Evidence
- Previous (2026-10-05..2026-10-11) → This week so far (2026-10-12..2026-10-14)
  - Net sales (order-date): ₹645,611 → ₹135,833. (Measured)
  - Orders (order-date): 339 → 72. (Measured)
  - Ad spend (delivery/report date): ₹430,736 → ₹90,799. (Measured)
  - Net profit (order-date P&L): −₹65,119 → ₹2,139. (Measured)

What the diagnostic found (summary of likely drivers)
- Largest mechanical contributors to the net-sales drop: a fall in gross/product net sales and materially lower ad spend on the same days (these lines moved and account for most of the change in the decomposition produced by the diagnostic). (Measured: the decomposition is reported by the diagnosis.)
- No single upstream cause met the causal threshold — the statistical engine did not label any driver as a supported cause. (Measured: diagnostic conclusion.)
- Metrics that moved together with sales (correlation / insufficient evidence): sessions and add‑to‑cart events declined with sales but the engine could not establish direction (they may be reaction or contributor). (Hypothesis / correlation)
- Places to check (diagnostic highlights): several campaigns/ad names showed big changes (some went to zero spend, while one ad rose ~₹24,962); these campaign-level shifts are good next probes. (Measured)
